Class XmlDataObjectSerializer<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Serialization
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides XML serialization and deserialization for objects of type T.

T must inherit from DataObject and should be compatible with XmlSerializer. 

public class XmlDataObjectSerializer<T> where T : DataObject

Type Parameters

T

The type of object to serialize/deserialize. Must inherit from DataObject and be XML serializable.

Remarks

This class supports both instance and static methods for serialization and deserialization. The instance methods allow customization of XmlWriterSettings and XmlSerializerNamespaces. The static methods provide convenience for quick serialization/deserialization without custom settings.
